title: Internet of Things: Sensing and Actuation From Devices
description: Interface sensors and actuators, acquire sensor data, and control devices such as stepper motors and LEDs.

title: Motors and Motor Control Circuits
description: Study AC and DC motors, motor selection, torque and speed, rotary sensors, and motor-control circuits.

title: Electric Motor Modeling and Control
description: Model electric motors and implement open-loop, closed-loop, PWM, and field-oriented control strategies.

title: Fundamentals of Digital Design for VLSI Chip Design
description: Learn digital logic, combinational and sequential circuits, FPGA concepts, memory systems, and the VLSI design flow.

title: Digital Signal Processing 1: Basic Concepts and Algorithms
description: Study discrete-time signals, vector-space representations, Fourier analysis, and core DSP algorithms.

title: Digital Signal Processing 2: Filtering
description: Learn digital filter design, filtering methods, and adaptive signal processing.

title: Digital Signal Processing 3: Analog vs Digital
description: Explore sampling, interpolation, quantization, A/D and D/A converters, and multirate signal processing.

title: Digital Signal Processing 4: Applications
description: Apply DSP methods to practical signal-processing and communication-system problems.

title: Fundamentals of Robotics & Industrial Automation
description: Explore industrial robotics, machine controls, manufacturing processes, and automation systems.

title: Robotic Technologies
description: Explore advanced robotic platforms, robot embodiment, human-robot interaction, humanoids, and soft robots.

title: Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control
description: Study robot kinematics, dynamics, motion planning, and control through mathematical models and applications.
